name: RedotPay Card
summary: RedotPay is a Hong Kong-based crypto card that lets you spend USDT, USDC, BTC and ETH wherever Visa is accepted. It pairs low FX fees with a usable virtual card, but it is not available everywhere and many features require identity verification.

kyc.notes: Email sign-up is enough to create an account, but issuing a card and raising limits requires a government ID and a liveness selfie. Some regions also ask for proof of address.

pros: Low 1.2% FX fee on non-USD spending
No monthly or annual card fee
Supports USDT, USDC, BTC and ETH across major networks
Works with Apple Pay and Google Pay
cons: Not available in the United States
Identity verification is required to unlock real limits
ATM withdrawals carry a 2% fee (min US$2)

variants.name: Physical
variants.cardInfo: Physical Visa, shipped after full KYC

faq.question: Is RedotPay available in the United States?
faq.answer: No. RedotPay is not offered to US residents. Availability varies by region, so check the app before completing verification.

faq.question: Do I need to complete KYC to use RedotPay?
faq.answer: You can create an account with just an email and phone number, but a government ID and selfie are required to issue a card and unlock higher limits.

faq.question: What cryptocurrencies does RedotPay support?
faq.answer: RedotPay supports USDT, USDC, BTC, ETH, BNB and SOL, with deposits over several networks including Ethereum, TRON, BSC, Solana and Polygon.

faq.question: Does RedotPay charge a monthly fee?
faq.answer: No. The card has no monthly or annual fee. You pay a one-off issuance fee and a 1.2% FX fee on non-USD transactions.
